description: One quiet line beside the date heading on the transcripts page, shown only on today and only once a device has captured something today. It states which device added the newest capture and the time it ends. It is a fact, not a verdict on whether capture is working. $device is the device's label as the journal names it elsewhere, such as "your phone · audio". $time is a time of day already formatted for the owner's locale, such as "2:14 PM".
context: Journal window, transcripts view. Beside the day heading, today only.
